## Activity

River Outreach recorded 20 captures during May 2021. Activity proceeded as expected, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available records indicate that the service maintained its scheduled outreach activity during the month. No operational issue was identified in the supplied activity information.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 4 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 20.0 per cent. This proportion should be monitored in subsequent reporting, as ungradable images cannot support a complete grading outcome. The finding provides a clear area for routine quality review and follow-up with staff where appropriate. It does not, on its own, indicate a change to the overall service schedule.

## Grading

A total of 2 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. Overall, the grading activity was completed alongside the reported capture work, with the available results recorded for review and onward management under the usual process. Further monitoring of image quality and grading timeliness will support ongoing oversight of River Outreach activity.
